description: Check that the saved Play Console session still works and list the signed-in Google accounts. Read-only: it never refreshes the session (refreshing a copied session signs the user out of Chrome). If the session has expired, the user reconnects with start_browser_auth.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

name: refresh_browser_session
